resources.string: Show the time in another zone in the seconds corner of the clock face, with its three-letter name. A + or - after the name means that zone is already tomorrow or still yesterday. Sent on every connect, so after a battery change it is back once the phone connects.
%1$s. Three letters A to Z; leave empty to use the name made from the zone.
Connect to the watch again as soon as the phone\'s Bluetooth is switched back on, without opening the app.
